title: Antah HealthCare Group
description: Antah Healthcare Group (AHCG) is one of Malaysia's leading integrated healthcare distribution and commercial partners, specializing in the nationwide marketing, sales, clinical regulatory support, and supply chain logistics of pharmaceuticals, medical equipment, and consumable products to hospitals and clinics.We successfully infiltrated AHCG's network and exfiltrated over 500 GB of highly sensitive data, including human resources and employee records, customer transaction histories, confidential commercial contracts, clinical and regulatory documentation, logistics tracking information, and financial statements.
